title: AAPS Client/ Websockets / BZ Sync
body:
Since the Beta 1 version, including the Devs versions, the BZ values ​​are no longer transmitted to the AAPS client when websockets are active. The rest goes through.
Master websockets ON, AAPSCLient1 websockets OFF - works perfectly, but slowly. AAPSCLient2 websockets OFF - does not work perfectly, breaks off at some point.
Since around 6:20 a.m. there has been no sync of the BZ values. Fully synchronizing NS fixes the error.

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18207147/AndroidAPS.log)
![Screenshot_20241220-075303](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4d272aa0-0ad0-49cd-8fba-5fc6f222efe7)

I found a bug in @olorinmaia case. NSCV1 was not properly shutdown after switching v1 -> v3. This is fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/6a670611df1dc8a87c9b6300c1a632fe6dc358d6
